en.headline: Hospital Authority to suspend Lok Ma Chau emergency hospital for upgrades
en.dek: Facility optimisation works starting next Tuesday cover ceiling insulation, flooring repairs, air-conditioning maintenance and a backup water tank, with services paused until the first quarter of 2027.
body: The Hospital Authority announced on Thursday that the Central Government-Aided Emergency Hospital in the Lok Ma Chau Loop, also known as the Hetao area, will begin facility optimisation works on October 20, according to the authority.

The hospital has been in operation since April 2023, more than three years, and facilities generally require maintenance after two to three years, a spokesman said. Works include replacing ceiling insulation materials, reinforcing and repairing frequently used floors, and performing regular maintenance on air-conditioning equipment to maintain the constant temperature and humidity needed for precision medical devices. A backup water tank will also be added to improve supply resilience in emergencies.

Services at the emergency hospital will be suspended during the works, which are expected to finish in the first quarter of 2027, after which they will resume. The timing in autumn and winter aims to avoid the rainy season.

Patients with appointments for radiological diagnostic services including CT, MRI and ultrasound will be redirected to their home hospital clusters, with hospitals contacting them to adjust dates and locations. Sleep-test patients will be prioritised by urgency, with emergency cases handled in home clusters and non-urgent ones rescheduled after reopening. The authority said it had already contacted patients for endoscopy and intraocular injection appointments.

zh.headline: 醫管局公布河套應急醫院下周二起進行設施優化工程
zh.dek: 工程涵蓋更換天花隔熱物料、加固地面、空調保養及加設備用水箱，期間暫停服務，預計明年第一季完成後恢復。
body: 醫院管理局今日公布，位於河套區的中央援港應急醫院將於本月20日（星期二）開始進行設施優化工程，為病人提供更佳治療環境。
醫管局發言人表示，應急醫院自2023年4月開始運作至今已超過三年，醫院設施一般在兩至三年需要進行執修工程。項目包括更換天花隔熱物料、加固及修復使用頻繁的地面，以及為空調設備進行定期保養，以維持精密醫療設備所需的恆溫恆濕環境。工程亦會加設備用水箱，提升供水系統在緊急情況下的應變韌性。
工程期間應急醫院將暫停服務，預計於明年第一季完成後恢復。工程安排於秋冬季節進行，希望盡量避開雨季，減低惡劣天氣對進度的影響。
已預約放射診斷服務（包括電腦掃描、磁力共振及超聲造影）的病人，將獲安排返回所屬醫院聯網跟進，醫院會陸續聯絡調整日期和地點。睡眠測試病人按緊急程度安排，優先處理緊急個案於所屬聯網，非緊急則待重開後進行。院方早前已聯絡內視鏡檢查及眼內注射預約的病人。
